audit.method: every attribute_coverage claim measured against WORKSPACE/data/all_products.json, category membership by path suffix

detail.verdict: claim is conservative - the combined attribute+title rule measures higher

audit.denominator_note: v0.3 numbers use category membership (a product counts if any of its paths ends in the leaf): 30 bearings, not the 22 that main_category returns. Membership is the right denominator for the engine, and v0.1/v0.2 used main_category - so their numbers were not comparable.

corrections.claim: chain rule ids aligned with live mechanicRules.ts
corrections.actual: PART-FORM, DRIVETRAIN-SPEED-RANGE and LENGTH-CUT-TO-FIT live in specSchemas.ts (4 occurrences). mechanicRules.ts holds RD-* ids including RD-MAX-COG-EXCEEDED. Both files are live; the provenance note was wrong, the ids are right.

enforcement_gap.problem: on_missing: ignore_unless_explicitly_requested cannot be implemented without a deterministic definition of 'explicitly requested'. v0.3 uses the phrase in 14 places but never says who decides it.
enforcement_gap.decision: a requested_params extractor runs over the free-text query + intent, is deterministic, and its output is echoed in the advice basis so the rider can see which constraints were applied.

third_state.when: conditional_veto attribute is missing on the row AND the parameter was requested
third_state.why: v0.3 states this only for BB-SPINDLE-LENGTH and HEADSET-SHIS; without generalising it, a requested constraint silently passes and the tool says fits on facts it never checked.
